sloka: यद्वै न्याय्यं मया कर्तुं तत् करिष्यामि सर्वथा।भूत्वा पर्वतसङ्काशो नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसम् ।। ६.६७.७५ ।।
transliteration: yadvai nyāyyaṁ mayā kartuṁ tat kariṣyāmi sarvathā।bhūtvā parvatasaṅkāśo nāśayiṣyāmi rākṣasam ।। 6.67.75 ।।

translations.english: 'Sugriva has been caught. What is my duty now? I will do what is just. I will destroy that Rakshasa who is in the form of a mountain', thought Maruti.
